research_summary: The pre-deadline search found a definitive Senesi yellow-card suspension and a weaker expert concern that Joao Pedro could be rested. The distinct evidence strengths are intentionally retained for the agent to weight.

sources.title: Who is suspended in the Premier League this week?
sources.citation_excerpt: Yellow card suspensions: David Brooks (Bournemouth); Marco Senesi (Bournemouth).
sources.claim_text: Marcos Senesi was suspended for GW14 after reaching the yellow-card threshold.

sources.title: Should I start, bench or sell Joao Pedro?
sources.citation_excerpt: Some Chelsea fans will say he is due a rest and a benching is on the cards whilst others will say he’s due a goal. This could come back to bite me but I think I would be looking to offload him if I didn’t have any other fires to put out in my team.
sources.claim_text: An FPL expert identified meaningful but contested rotation risk for Joao Pedro and preferred selling if no higher-priority issue existed.
